name: Shinkai Takehito
source:
A third-year and member of the Firefolk.

Aiming to become a pro wrestler, he never misses a day of training.

He’s compassionate, but he can be a bit pushy at times.

His ability is Super Strength, granting extraordinary might.

His body is his weapon.

(from Kagura Games' store)
